text: Automating smart contracts under the code is law paradigm incentivizes unethical behavior by enabling anonymous, opportunistic action, which reduces repeat business and undermines the minimization of transaction costs.
citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5554218

isBasedOn.name: Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era

abstract: The automation of smart contracts under "code is law" incentivizes unethical behavior by enabling anonymous, opportunistic actions, reducing repeat business and undermining transaction cost minimization.
